rationale: C23 is a direct drafting predecessor: it authorizes the same Senate Committee on Government Operations to inspect the same six categories of tax returns, during the immediately preceding Congress, for virtually identical studies of Government activities aimed at determining economy and efficiency. The child mainly updates the covered years and Congress and revises the Treasury-decision reference. C04 and C05 are also close templates, but C04 uses the predecessor committee name and C05 applies to the House committee.

shared_material.child_excerpt: any income, excess-profits, declared-value excess-profits, capital-stock, estate, or gift tax return for the years 1945 to 1954, inclusive
shared_material.parent_excerpt: any income, excess-profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate, or gift tax return for the years 1945 to 1952, inclusive
shared_material.explanation: The same distinctive enumeration and starting year are retained, with the terminal year updated.

shared_material.child_excerpt: shall, during the Eighty-fourth Congress, be open to inspection by the Senate Committee on Government Operations, or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: shall, during the Eighty-third Congress, be open to inspection by the Senate Committee on Government Operations or the duly authorized subcommittee thereof
shared_material.explanation: The operative authorization is substantially identical, with only the Congress updated and minor wording changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: in connection with its studies of the operation of Government activities at all levels with a view to determining the economy and efficiency of the Government
shared_material.parent_excerpt: in connection with its studies of the operation of Government activities at all levels with a view to determining its economy and efficiency
shared_material.explanation: The same specific investigative purpose is reproduced almost verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury
shared_material.parent_excerpt: subject to the conditions stated in the Treasury decision relating to the inspection of such returns by that Committee
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same administrative machinery—inspection governed by a contemporaneously approved Treasury decision—although the child updates its formulation.
